counting_policy: 288 non-Bevy tests plus 42 demo tests plus 42 Bevy render-library tests plus 21 Bevy integrations. The 23 headless-library cases are also in the render-library suite and counted once. Earlier attempts, targeted reruns, examples, CLI smoke and native interactions are excluded from the Rust total.
scope: Bounded local correctness, actual localhost TCP/TLS, regional SQLite recovery, and Linux/X11 native interaction with Mesa software Vulkan. No full Motor Town parity, AAA quality, gaming-GPU performance, public authentication, distributed authority, or MMORPG concurrency certification.
